method: The pinned self-citation procedure (after Timm & Schinner 2020), fitted on the practice training pages only and then writing the shape of every page of the book: each word copies a word written recently on the same page and changes it by 0 to 2 glyph edits drawn from the training glyph inventory. Nothing in the procedure knows what a word means, and nothing counts, avoids or targets repeated sequences: the low three-word repetition falls out of the mechanism itself, because a copy is never an exact copy of a long run. F-024 holds on this text, so it is not evidence that the manuscript was produced by something with language behind it. The same held for all four pinned generators at cut 'lines' (table-cipher 0.00239, self-citation 0.0, grille 0.0, line-chain 0.0, against the manuscript's 0.0029), so F-024 is reproduced by every meaningless procedure on the record, not by one lucky fit.
